description: Zendesk provides a support and helpdesk platform with API access for managing support tickets, users, and other resources. description: The Google Ads API is a programmatic interface for managing Google Ads accounts and campaigns, suitable for large or complex setups. Typical uses include automated account management, custom reporting, ad management based on inventory, and Smart Bidding strategy management. It is recommended for developers comfortable with writing code and managing their own software infrastructure.

description: Notion provides a REST API for interacting with workspace content, including pages, databases, and users. It supports internal connections with static API tokens, personal access tokens (user-scoped static tokens), and public connections using OAuth 2.0. The API allows reading, creating, and updating Notion content.
api_breadth: The API supports workspace content management including pages, databases, users, comments, markdown content, files, and media. It offers personal access tokens, internal connections, and public OAuth connections for authentication. The API includes endpoints for authorization, content manipulation, and user management.
